items.basis: ERA performance pay (Leistungszulage / Leistungsentgelt), works average: BW 15%, Bavaria 14%, Lower Saxony 10%, NRW 10% (NRW: individual 0–20%; works average not found — 10% ASSUMED as the midpoint of that range; the other regions 6–15% per the same source)

items.basis: Each region's Eckentgelt (reference skilled-worker rate) incl. average performance pay: BW EG 7 3,703.50 × 1.15 = 4259.02; BY EG 5 A 3,497.00 × 1.14 = 3986.58; NI EG 5 C 3,614.69 × 1.10 = 3976.16; NRW EG 9 3,561.00 × 1.10 = 3917.10; 4-cluster mean 4034.72 ÷ BW 4259.02 = 0.9473. Role pay = BW ERA group Grundentgelt × 1.15 × 0.9473 (BW has the finest 17-group ladder; the factor moves it to the 4-cluster average).
items.notes: Derived from the four regional ERA tables above. Cross-check, skilled role mapped region by region (BW EG 8 × 1.15 = 4,556.88; BY EG 6 B 3,843 × 1.14 = 4,381.02; NI EG 6 C 3,786 × 1.10 = 4,164.60; NRW EG 10 3,914 × 1.10 = 4,305.40; mean 4,351.98) v the factor method 4,316.79 — within 0.8%.

items.basis: Additional holiday pay 50% of the daily average pay per holiday day: 30 days × 0.5 × (monthly × 3 ÷ 65 working days in 13 weeks) = 0.6923 × monthly (≈ the 69% of a month quoted)
items.notes: Collective agreement (MTV/Urlaubsabkommen). IG Metall pages state 50% per holiday day; the 69% of a month figure is the same rule.

items.basis: Tarifliche Sonderzahlung (13th-month share): up to 55% of a monthly pay after 36 months' service (25–55% by tenure) — 55% used (established workforce)
items.notes: Collective agreement.

items.basis: T-ZUG A = 27.5% of individual monthly pay, paid with July payroll (can be swapped for days off by shift workers, carers, parents)
items.notes: Collective agreement.

items.basis: Transformationsgeld (T-Geld) = 18.4% of monthly pay, paid in July since the 2024 agreement
items.notes: Collective agreement.

items.basis: T-ZUG B raised from 18.5% to 26.5% of the region's Eckentgelt from Feb 2026 (paid in February, on the table then valid = 2025 values): 0.265 × mean 2025 Eckentgelt (BW 3,703.50, BY 3,497.00, NI 3,614.69, NRW 3,561.00 → mean 3,594.05 ÷ 1.031 = 3,485.98) = 923.79; IG Metall quotes €845–952 by region
items.notes: Collective agreement. BW check: 0.265 × 3,703.50 ÷ 1.031 = 951.9 = the €952 top of the quoted range.

items.unit: months of monthly pay / yr (+ T-ZUG B)
items.basis: Urlaubsgeld 0.6923 + Weihnachtsgeld 0.55 + T-ZUG A 0.275 + T-Geld 0.184 = 1.7013 monthly pays + T-ZUG B 923.79 EUR flat

items.unit: fraction of hourly pay, per late-shift hour 12:00–19:00
items.basis: MTV Metall BW (2024 version, §§ on Spätarbeit): 20% for each Spätarbeit hour between 12:00 and 19:00 where the regular shift starts after 12:00 and ends after 19:00
items.notes: Collective agreement (BW). Bavaria, Lower Saxony and NRW late-shift rules NOT found; the BW rule is applied to all four clusters (stated proxy).

items.unit: fraction of hourly pay, averaged over both shifts
items.basis: Shifts 06:00–14:00 and 14:00–22:00: late-shift hours 14:00–19:00 = 5 h × 20% = 1.0 premium-hour per late shift; ÷ 16 h over both shifts = 6.25% of base hourly pay on hours worked. Applied as 0.0625 × (monthly ÷ 152.25 h) × 1,466.78 productive h = 0.6021 × monthly per year
items.notes: Hours 19:00–22:00 carry NO premium here: whether they are Nachtarbeit (higher premium) under each regional MTV was NOT confirmed — if so, the loaded shop-floor rates rise by ~€1–1.5/h. Night/third shift and weekends are outside the 2 × 8 h pattern.
